title.description: Diagram title. Rendered as the SVG <title> for accessibility.

direction.description: Layout flow direction: edges run from source to target left-to-right ("right") or top-to-bottom ("down"). The only layout hint; positions are computed automatically and are deterministic.

id.description: Unique identifier referenced by edges. Letters, digits, '_', '.', '-'; must start with a letter or digit.

label.description: Text shown in the node box. Defaults to the id.

nodes.description: Components of the system. Order matters: nodes in the same rank are placed in this order, so list the important ones first.

to.description: Target node id. The arrowhead is drawn here.

label.description: Short text drawn at the edge midpoint, e.g. a protocol or purpose.

load.description: Relative traffic on this edge, 0 to 1. Drives the flow animation: 0 hides the flow, 1 is the fastest and thickest dashes. Use it for relative intensity, not real units.

edges.description: Directed connections. Each 'from'/'to' must be an existing node id (checked by the validator); self-references and duplicate node ids are rejected.
